source: That’s truly unfortunate… I’m sorry to hear that.
translation: 这真的很不幸……听到这个我很难过。

source: I hope you understand, Mr. Clermont, but there’s just some unexpected things that occurred yesterday…
translation: 希望您能理解，Clermont先生，但昨天发生了一些意外……

source: I will be taking over in Goro’s place for the time being…
translation: 暂时由我接替 Goro……

source: Please don’t worry about the offer anymore, and do what you have to for the project and camp!
translation: 请别再担心那个提议，去做您为项目和营地必须做的事！

source: I really appreciate your concern, Mr. Clermont. Thank you for understanding.
translation: 我真的很感激您的关心，Clermont先生。谢谢您的理解。

source: Of course! Let me know if there’s anything I can do to help.
translation: 当然！如果有什么我能帮忙的，请告诉我。

source: I think we settled it in the best way possible, Yuri.
translation: 我想我们以最好的方式解决了这件事，Yuri。

source: Yeah… Thanks for handling it, Yoshi…
translation: 是啊……谢谢你处理这件事，Yoshi……

source: I spoke with Dad over the phone this morning too… He doesn’t plan on coming back yet but he was apologizing for leaving everything behind.
translation: 我今天早上也和爸爸通了电话……他还不打算回来，但他为抛下一切而道歉。

source: I just reassured him that we can handle everything here at camp for now.
translation: 我只是让他放心，我们目前能处理好营地这里的一切。

source: I’m sorry, Yuri… I really tried hard to convince him…
translation: 对不起，Yuri……我真的努力说服过他……

source: But it looks like I didn’t handle it in the best way…
translation: 但看来我没有以最好的方式处理……

source: It’s not your fault, Yoshi… There must’ve been something we all didn’t understand about him...
translation: 这不是你的错，Yoshi……他身上一定有我们所有人都不理解的东西……

source: Dad already did this once after you left the first term… Keeping everything to himself, and pushing everyone away…
translation: 你在第一期离开后，爸爸已经这样做过一次……把一切藏在心里，把所有人推开……

source: Maybe I should try to reach out and help…
translation: 也许我该试着联系他、帮助他……

source: Forcing things on him will just make things worse… So, I’m afraid there’s really not much we do…
translation: 强迫他只会让事情更糟……所以，恐怕我们真的无能为力……

source: Will he be okay…?
translation: 他会没事吗……？

source: I’m still in contact with him at the very least, I’ll make sure he’s okay and try to change his mind.
translation: 至少我还和他保持联系，我会确保他没事，并试着改变他的想法。

source: But try not to worry about it and just focus on keeping the project going until the end.
translation: 但尽量别担心，只要专注于让项目进行到最后。

source: You’re right… That’s the best thing we can do until he comes back.
translation: 你说得对……这是在他回来前我们能做的最好的事。

source: {i}Yuri and I left the office and explained the situation to everyone... We were all upset about Goro's sudden departure, but none of us wanted to give up on the project.{/i}
translation: {i}Yuri 和我离开办公室，向大家解释了情况……我们都因 Goro 的突然离开而难过，但没有人想放弃这个项目。{/i}

source: {i}Everyone worked hard for the next few months, and I did my best to lead in Goro's place.{/i}
translation: {i}接下来的几个月里，大家都努力工作，而我尽力代替 Goro 领导大家。{/i}

source: You’ve all worked extremely hard, and I want to express how thankful I am for all of your dedication and commitment!
translation: 你们所有人都非常努力，我想表达自己对你们奉献与投入的感激！

source: It was my pleasure, Mr. Nagira.
translation: 这是我的荣幸，Nagira先生。

source: I know that for many of us, today is bittersweet without our leader, but I’m sure that no matter where he is, he’s proud of us.
translation: 我知道，没有我们的领导者，今天对许多人来说苦乐参半，但我相信无论他在哪里，他都为我们骄傲。

source: We’ve all done our best to continue his dream, and one day, if he comes back, Camp Buddy will be here for him again.
translation: 我们都尽力延续他的梦想，总有一天，如果他回来，Camp Buddy 会再次在这里等他。

source: Now, let’s usher in a bright future, together!
translation: 现在，让我们一起迎接光明的未来！

source: {i}Even though we should’ve been celebrating with the ribbon-cutting, I couldn’t help but feel hollow inside…{/i}
translation: {i}尽管我们本该在剪彩时庆祝，我仍不由得感到内心空虚……{/i}

source: {i}This was everything Goro dreamed of… or so I thought.{/i}
translation: {i}这本是 Goro 梦想的一切……至少我曾这样以为。{/i}

source: {i}I wish he could’ve been here today…{/i}
translation: {i}我希望他今天能在这里……{/i}

source: {i}After the ceremony, everyone packed up, and it was time to say goodbye.{/i}
translation: {i}仪式结束后，大家收拾好东西，到了告别的时候。{/i}

source: *sigh* It feels so wrong to leave now, especially without Sir Goro around…
translation: *叹气* 现在离开感觉太不对了，尤其是没有 Goro先生 在身边……

source: Y-Yeah… I kept hoping that he’d show up at the ceremony at least.
translation: 是、是啊……我一直希望他至少会出现在仪式上。

source: You said you heard from him right, Yuri?
translation: 你说你有他的消息，对吧，Yuri？

source: I did text him letting him know about today… He said to congratulate everyone, but that he wouldn’t make it.
translation: 我确实发消息告诉他今天的事……他说向大家祝贺，但他不会来。

source: *sigh* I guess he’s still not ready to come back, huh?
translation: *叹气* 我想他还是没准备好回来，对吧？

source: D-Don’t worry, everyone! I’m sure he’ll be back someday!
translation: 别、别担心，大家！我相信他总有一天会回来！

source: He just really needs some time to himself for now… Once he gets through with it, he’ll want to see all of us again.
translation: 他现在只是非常需要一些独处时间……一旦熬过去，他会想再见我们所有人。

source: Y-Yeah, you’re probably right, Yuri! He’ll probably have some crazy stories to tell, too!
translation: 是、是啊，你可能说得对，Yuri！他大概也会有些疯狂故事可讲！

source: Awww, now I can’t wait to hear them! I hope it’s soon…
translation: 啊啊，现在我等不及想听了！希望很快就能听到……

source: For now, we just have to be patient.
translation: 现在，我们只能耐心等待。

source: A-Ah, that must be our shuttle… I guess it’s time to leave…
translation: 啊、啊，那一定是我们的接驳车……我想是该离开了……

source: See ya, guys! It’s been a pleasure working with everyone!
translation: 回见，各位！和大家一起工作很愉快！

source: Huhuhuhu… Be sure to keep in touch!
translation: 呜呜呜……一定要保持联系！

source: *sniff* This place just feels so empty now…
translation: *抽鼻子* 这个地方现在感觉好空……

source: Come on, let’s get you inside. We can watch a nice movie and get it off our minds.
translation: 来吧，我们带你进去。我们可以看部好电影，把这件事从脑海中赶走。

source: …You alright, Yoshi?
translation: ……你还好吗，Yoshi？

source: Y-Yeah, I’ll be fine, Aiden.
translation: 是、是啊，我会没事的，Aiden。

source: You can go ahead, I’ll catch up.
translation: 你先走吧，我会跟上。

source: …Okay. Don’t stay out here too long.
translation: ……好吧。别在外面待太久。

source: {i}As I stood there at the arches of Camp Buddy alone, I was left to wonder about the choices I’ve made…{/i}
translation: {i}当我独自站在 Camp Buddy 的拱门前，我只能思考自己做出的选择……{/i}

source: {i}Even though Goro and I thought we had gained so much throughout the seasons… In the end I felt like I lost everything…{/i}
translation: {i}尽管 Goro 和我曾以为在这些日子里收获了许多……到最后，我却觉得失去了一切……{/i}

source: {i}My only hope now is that he’ll come back one day and see how I’ve kept the camp alive for him…{/i}
translation: {i}我现在唯一的希望，是有一天他会回来，看到我如何为他让营地继续存在……{/i}

source: {i}Until then, all the memories we shared together will keep replaying in my head, holding on to what’s left of the love I had for him…{/i}
translation: {i}在那之前，我们共同拥有的所有回忆都会不断在我脑中重演，我会抓住自己对他所剩的爱……{/i}
